scripts.start: npm run prerender -- --env environment=local && webpack serve --env environment=local
scripts.build: npm run prerender -- --env environment=local && webpack --env environment=local
scripts.publish: npm run prerender -- --env environment=production && webpack --env environment=production
scripts.publish:oss: npm run prerender -- --env environment=oss && webpack --env environment=oss
scripts.analyze: npm run prerender && webpack --config webpack.analyze.config.js --env environment=local
